SELECT
  customer_id,
  event_datetime,
  event_type,
  event_category,
  event_description,
  amount,
  channel,
  direction,
  event_status,
  CASE
    WHEN event_date = current_date()               THEN 'Today'
    WHEN event_date = DATE_SUB(current_date(), 1)  THEN 'Yesterday'
    WHEN event_date >= DATE_SUB(current_date(), 7) THEN 'This week'
    ELSE DATE_FORMAT(event_date, 'dd MMM yyyy')
  END AS when_label

FROM customer_360.gold.activity_feed

ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, 
  event_datetime DESC

datasets.name: b099948c
queryLines:
SELECT
  primary_segment,
  COUNT(*)                                     AS total_customers,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 2) AS segment_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(total_balance), 2)                 AS avg_balance,
  ROUND(AVG(credit_score), 0)                  AS avg_credit_score,
  ROUND(AVG(engagement_score), 1)              AS avg_engagement,
  ROUND(AVG(churn_risk_score), 1)              AS avg_churn_risk,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_monthly_spending), 2)          AS avg_monthly_spend,
  ROUND(AVG(total_products), 1)                AS avg_products
FROM customer_360.gold.customer_segments
GROUP BY primary_segment
ORDER BY total_customers DESC

datasets.name: ee4886f7
queryLines:
SELECT
  primary_segment,
  COUNT(*)                                     AS customers,
  ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(), 2) AS pct,
  ROUND(SUM(total_balance), 2)                 AS total_deposits,
  ROUND(AVG(total_balance), 2)                 AS avg_deposit,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_affluent         THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS affluent_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_mass_market      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mass_market_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_digital_champion THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS digital_champion_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_at_risk          THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS at_risk_count
FROM customer_360.gold.customer_segments
GROUP BY primary_segment
ORDER BY customers DESC

datasets.name: f58b392f
queryLines:
SELECT
  primary_segment,
  ROUND(MIN(total_balance), 2)                 AS min_balance,
  ROUND(MAX(total_balance), 2)                 AS max_balance,
  ROUND(AVG(total_balance), 2)                 AS avg_balance,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE(total_balance, 0.5), 2)     AS median_balance,
  COUNT(*)                                     AS customers
FROM customer_360.gold.customer_segments
GROUP BY primary_segment
ORDER BY avg_balance DESC

datasets.name: 58325d0d
queryLines:
SELECT
  'Mortgage'             AS product,
  mortgage_priority      AS priority,
  COUNT(*)               AS customers,
  ROUND(AVG(mortgage_probability), 1) AS avg_probability
FROM customer_360.gold.product_recommendations
GROUP BY mortgage_priority

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Wealth Product'       AS product,
  wealth_priority        AS priority,
  COUNT(*)               AS customers,
  ROUND(AVG(wealth_probability), 1) AS avg_probability
FROM customer_360.gold.product_recommendations
GROUP BY wealth_priority

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'Credit Card Upgrade'  AS product,
  credit_card_priority   AS priority,
  COUNT(*)               AS customers,
  ROUND(AVG(credit_card_upgrade_probability), 1) AS avg_probability
FROM customer_360.gold.product_recommendations
GROUP BY credit_card_priority
ORDER BY product, priority

datasets.name: fe8eb1db
queryLines:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  full_name,
  city,
  primary_segment,
  credit_score,
  credit_category,
  ROUND(total_balance, 2)                        AS total_balance,
  ROUND(avg_monthly_spending, 2)                 AS avg_monthly_spending,
  mortgage_probability,
  mortgage_priority,
  wealth_probability,
  wealth_priority,
  credit_card_upgrade_probability,
  credit_card_priority,
  top_recommendation,
  engagement_score,
  churn_risk_score,

  CASE
    WHEN churn_risk_score < 30 THEN 'Low'
    WHEN churn_risk_score < 60 THEN 'Medium'
    ELSE                            'High'
  END                                            AS churn_risk_tier,

  CONCAT(
    '🎯 TOP RECOMMENDATION: ', top_recommendation, '\n\n',
    '📞 WHAT TO SAY TO ', UPPER(full_name), ':\n',
    CASE top_recommendation
      WHEN 'Mortgage' THEN
        CONCAT('"', full_name, ', based on your excellent savings balance of $',
               FORMAT_NUMBER(total_balance, 0),
               ' and your strong credit profile, you are pre-qualified for our ',
               'home loan program. Would you like to explore our current mortgage rates?"')
      WHEN 'Wealth Product' THEN
        CONCAT('"', full_name, ', given your financial strength and investment ',
               'potential, our wealth management team would love to show you how ',
               'your money can work harder. Can we schedule a private consultation?"')
      ELSE
        CONCAT('"', full_name, ', as one of our valued customers, you qualify for ',
               'a credit card upgrade with higher limits and premium rewards. ',
               'Would you like to hear more?"')
    END, '\n',
    '\n💼 WHY THIS RECOMMENDATION:\n',
    '• Mortgage Score     : ', mortgage_probability,
      '/100 (', mortgage_priority, ' priority)\n',
    '• Wealth Score       : ', wealth_probability,
      '/100 (', wealth_priority, ' priority)\n',
    '• Card Upgrade Score : ', credit_card_upgrade_probability,
      '/100 (', credit_card_priority, ' priority)\n',
    '\n⚡ BANKER ACTION:\n',
    CASE
      WHEN mortgage_priority = 'High'
      THEN '1. Call within 48 hours — high mortgage conversion probability\n2. Prepare mortgage rate sheet before calling\n3. Log call outcome in CRM'
      WHEN wealth_priority = 'High'
      THEN '1. Schedule private wealth consultation this week\n2. Prepare portfolio performance report\n3. Invite to next wealth management event'
      WHEN credit_card_priority = 'High'
      THEN '1. Send upgrade offer via preferred channel (mobile/email)\n2. Follow up in 3 days if no response\n3. Offer instant approval if called'
      ELSE '1. Maintain relationship — regular quarterly check-in\n2. Monitor for life events (salary increase, home search)\n3. Re-evaluate in 90 days'
    END
  )                                              AS banker_action_script,

  CASE
    WHEN churn_risk_score >= 60 THEN '🚨 HIGH CHURN RISK — Prioritise retention over cross-sell'
    WHEN churn_risk_score >= 30 THEN '⚠️ MEDIUM CHURN RISK — Lead with value, not product push'
    ELSE                             '✅ LOW CHURN RISK — Good time to introduce new product'
  END                                            AS risk_warning

FROM customer_360.gold.product_recommendations
ORDER BY mortgage_probability DESC
